signals.entity: Croatian commercial banks (Zaba, PBZ, Erste, OTP, RBA, HPB, Addiko)
signals.signal: NONE FOUND — explicitly. Searching EOJN and TED for 'bankomat' (ATM), ATM CPVs and self-service terminals returns zero notices from Croatian commercial banks. This is structural, not a coverage gap: Croatian commercial banks are private companies and are NOT obveznici Zakona o javnoj nabavi (not subject to the Public Procurement Act), so they buy ATMs, recyclers, POS terminals and self-service kiosks by private RFP with no public notice. Every Croatian ATM/cash-automation signal that IS public comes from HNB (central bank), FINA (state financial agency) or HP - Hrvatska pošta (state-owned postal operator).
signals.implies: Portal monitoring will never surface Croatian commercial-bank ATM/POS demand. Printec's Croatian pipeline for categories (1), (2), (3) must be built through direct relationship coverage and vendor (NCR Atleos, Verifone) channel intelligence, not through EOJN.
signals.likelihood: Permanent structural feature of the Croatian market
signals.followup: Reallocate Croatian coverage effort: keep EOJN/TED alerts only on HNB, FINA, HP and Zagrebački holding; cover commercial banks via direct account contact and HUB (Croatian Banking Association) channels.
